description: This file defines a Java class 'FileBasedRegistrationService' which implements device registration management for an IoT platform, storing data in-memory with optional file persistence. It handles device CRUD operations, loading/saving device data, and integrates with various services and configurations.
external_methods: updateDevice(String, String, Device, Optional<String>, Span, Handler)

classes.name: FileBasedRegistrationService
classes.description: A Spring component implementing device registration management in memory with optional file persistence, supporting device CRUD operations, loading/saving device data, and integrating with other services.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the service, optionally loads device data from file, and sets up periodic save;

methods.name: loadRegistrationData
methods.description: Loads device registration data from a specified JSON file into memory.

methods.name: checkFileExists
methods.description: Checks if the data file exists, optionally creating it if missing.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds device data from a JSON buffer loaded from file.

methods.name: addDevicesForTenant
methods.description: Loads device entries for a tenant from a JSON object.

methods.name: mapFromStoredJson
methods.description: Converts stored JSON data into a Device object.

methods.name: mapToStoredJson
methods.description: Converts a Device object into JSON for storage.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the service, periodically saving device data if necessary.

methods.name: saveToFile
methods.description: Persists in-memory device data to the configured JSON file.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Delegates registration assertion to internal registration service.

methods.name: getDevice
methods.description: Retrieves a device's registration data and returns it.

methods.name: convertResult
methods.description: Converts internal operation result to a RegistrationResult object.

methods.name: convertDevice
methods.description: Converts device data into JSON format suitable for responses.

methods.name: readDevice
methods.description: Reads device registration data from in-memory storage.

methods.name: deleteDevice
methods.description: Deletes a device entry if found and resource version matches.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Creates or adds a new device with specified data.

methods.name: updateDevice
methods.description: Updates existing device data if resource version matches.

methods.name: doUpdateDevice
methods.description: Performs the actual update of a device, ensuring resource version validity.

methods.name: getDevicesForTenant
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes device map for a tenant.

methods.name: getCacheDirective
methods.description: Provides cache control directives based on configuration.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all registered devices from memory.

methods.name: generateDeviceId
methods.description: Generates a new UUID-based device ID that is unique within the tenant.
